_comment: Detection thresholds and timers. EVERY value here is a PLACEHOLDER chosen only so the simulator runs.
Before any measured test, set them from: the sensor reading with supply removed (noise floor),
the normal variation of the test supply, the firmware report interval, and the relay operate time.
Voltage thresholds are per-unit (pu) of nominal_voltage_v in feeder.json.
See docs/STATE_MACHINE.md section 2 for what each parameter does.

uv_dropout_pu.note: Leave LOW band at or above this (hysteresis).

loss_pickup_pu.note: Enter ABSENT band below this. Must be above the sensor noise floor.

loss_dropout_pu.note: Leave ABSENT band at or above this.

transient_dip_pu.note: A dip below this (sample or per-cycle minimum) counts as a transient.

uv_persistence_ms.note: LOW must persist this long to confirm undervoltage.

loss_persistence_ms.note: ABSENT must persist this long to confirm supply loss.

recovery_stability_ms.note: Supply must stay normal this long to be called stable.

restored_hold_ms.note: RESTORED is shown this long before the event closes.

reclose_supply_timeout_ms.note: After a reported reclose, supply must return within this time.

stale_after_ms.note: No valid data for this long -> STALE.

offline_after_ms.note: No valid data for this long -> OFFLINE.

controller_offline_after_ms.note: No report from a controller for this long -> controller offline.

init_timeout_ms.note: Max time in INITIALIZING before DEGRADED/UNKNOWN.

isolation_feedback_timeout_ms.note: Feedback must report OPEN this soon after isolation is commanded.

transient_display_hold_ms.note: How long the feeder shows TRANSIENT.

transient_max_events_per_min.note: Per feeder; extra dips are counted on the last event.

protection_disagreement_ms.note: Controller/server supply judgements must differ this long to log it.

tick_interval_ms.note: Software re-evaluation period for timers (not a hardware setting).
